edges.economic_rationale: Retail overreaction to news/momentum creates temporary price extremes; algorithms and market makers fade these; Statistical arbitrage: extreme deviations attract mean-reverting flow from prop desks and HFTs; Volatility clustering (Mandelbrot): large moves beget large moves — statistical fact of financial time series; Stop-loss cascades: leveraged retail positions get liquidated, accelerating the move; GBPUSD has strong institutional participation; Low WR (52%) — edge too weak for reliable exploitation; Recency + representativeness — 'this time is different' thinking at extremes, usually wrong; Lower timeframe (M15) — behavioral biases are weaker, noise dominates
